title: Ship in three days
notes: Packages 4 7 2 6 3 5 1 8 leave in order, and d = 3. The answer lies between 8 (the heaviest package) and 36 (all of them in one day). mid = 22 fits and so does 15; 11 and 13 fail; 14 fits. Capacity 14 ships them as 4 7 2, then 6 3 5, then 1 8. 5 checks and 40 reads, against 7 checks and 49 reads for trying every capacity upward.
